## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `salesforce-marketingcloud-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to Marketing Cloud

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to your [Salesforce Marketing Cloud login page](https://mc.exacttarget.com/cloud/login.html) and log in. -->
2. Select your username in the top-right corner and select **Setup** from the dropdown menu.

## Step 3: Create an installed package

1. In the **Setup** menu, scroll to the **Platform Tools** section and select **Apps > Installed Packages**.
2. Select **New**, enter a **Name** and **Description** (for example, `API Integration Package`), and select **Save**.
3. <!-- manual: Select New, enter a Name and Description (for example, API Integration Package), and select Save. -->

## Step 4: Add an API integration component

1. <!-- manual: Select the package you created to view its details. -->
2. Select **Add Component** and choose **API Integration** as the component type.
3. Select **Server-to-Server** as the integration type.
4. <!-- manual: Under the available scopes, select the permissions required for your integration. For most use cases, add: -->
5. <!-- manual: Read and Write access to Email Studio -->
6. <!-- manual: Access to the REST API -->
7. Select **Save**.
